programme.title: షవర్స్ ఆఫ్ బ్లెస్సింగ్స్ - విషెస్
programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత హృదయపూర్వక పుట్టినరోజు, వార్షికోత్సవ శుభాకాంక్షలతో వివిధ గాయకులు,సంగీతకారులు శ్రావ్యమైన పాటలను ప్రదర్శిస్తారు.

programme.title: టీడబ్ల్యూఆర్
programme.desc: అత్యుత్తమ టెలివిజన్ కార్యక్రమాలు.

programme.title: వెకేట్
programme.desc: ఒక పాస్టర్ మతం, మతపరమైన విషయాలను, లెన్స్, క్రీస్తు బోధనల దృక్కోణంపై చర్చిస్తాడు, మంచి జీవితాన్ని అనుసరించమని కోరతారు.

programme.title: పి జి స్టీఫెన్ పాల్
programme.desc: పి జె స్టీఫెన్ పాల్ పవిత్ర బైబిలులోని శ్లోకాలను చదువుతూ ప్రసంగించి, అనుచరులను నీతివంతమైన జీవితం గడపమని ప్రోత్సహిస్తారు.

programme.title: సిస్టర్ జాయ్ చెరియన్
programme.desc: సిస్టర్ జాయ్ చెరియన్ విశ్వాసకులకు దేవుని కృప, జీవితంలో బైబిలు బోధనలను అనుసరించవలసిన ప్రాముఖ్యత గురించి వివరిస్తారు.

programme.title: వెకేట్

programme.title: Journey to the West: Conquering the Demons

programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.

programme.title: George and the Dragon

programme.desc: Marie meets skydiver Maxime, who unbeknownst to her is a thief. After his boss Sophia sabotages Marie's parachute, she miraculously survives a 3,000-metre fall and seeks revenge on them.

programme.title: Tron: Legacy
programme.desc: Yearning for his absent father, Sam enters a now-perilous virtual world his dad designed. As they reunite, father and son brave a life-or-death journey through the dangerous digital realm.

programme.title: The Marvels
programme.desc: While attempting to fight off Kree enemies, Captain Marvel finds herself connected to Monica Rambeau and Kamala Khan through their quantum powers.

programme.title: Moana

programme.title: Transformers One
programme.desc: Set on the Transformer home planet of Cybertron, two mining robots without the ability to transform become friends and unlock the ancient secret that allows them to eventually become Optimus Prime and Megatron.

programme.title: A Quiet Place: Day One
programme.desc: Sam navigates a living nightmare in an invaded New York City, struggling to survive in silence against deadly creatures with ultra sensitive hearing.

programme.title: Black Panther
programme.desc: T'Challa, the prince of Wakanda, returns to his nation to become king after his father's death. However, he faces a challenger who wants to take over his kingdom and its resources.

programme.title: The Good Dinosaur
programme.desc: After a devastating flood separates him from his family, Arlo teams up with a young human called Spot as they journey across dangerous lands to find their way home.

programme.title: Alien: Romulus
programme.desc: A crew of space colonisers boards a derelict station in search of valuable resources. Their routine scavenging mission becomes a fight for survival against a deadly entity.

programme.title: Transformers One
programme.desc: Set on the Transformer home planet of Cybertron, two mining robots without the ability to transform become friends and unlock the ancient secret that allows them to eventually become Optimus Prime and Megatron.

programme.title: Terminator: Dark Fate
programme.desc: When an advanced Terminator is sent into the past, a cyborg and a seasoned female warrior team up to stop the death of a young woman who is fated to ensure the survival of the human race.

programme.title: Hansel and Gretel
programme.desc: A deranged recluse enslaves teenage siblings in her horrifying home.

programme.title: Samson
programme.desc: Samson, a Nazirite, takes on the role of rescuing Israelites from the oppression. However, he soon finds himself caught up in the evil machinations of a prince, which leads him to seek revenge.

programme.title: Breaking Infinity
programme.desc: Time-jumping scientist Liam, guided by a mysterious elder, travels to a future where he sees global destruction he might have caused.

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A young motorbike rider must master his new-found powers to confront the emergence of centuries-old enemy forces and settle a 3000-year-old battle.

programme.title: Filler
programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.

programme.title: Gremlins
programme.desc: Billy's father gets him a pet from China with three very specific instructions. However, when Billy does not follow them, it unleashes a horde of monsters.

programme.title: Jurassic City
programme.desc: After the security of a top-secret laboratory is compromised, genetically modified dinosaurs get unleashed. Then, a black-ops unit is tasked with capturing the creatures before they cause more damage.

programme.title: Upon the Magic Roads
programme.desc: Foal and his loyal friend John embark on a journey across magical roads.

programme.title: The Haunted Mansion
programme.desc: A family vacation takes a detour when workaholic realtor Jim Evers stops to close a deal at a remote mansion. However, they soon realise the estate is haunted by a restless spirit.

programme.title: Ice Age
programme.desc: Manny the mammoth, Sid the loquacious sloth, and Diego the saber-toothed tiger go on a comical quest to return a human baby to his father, across a world on the brink of an ice age.

programme.title: விண்ணைத்தாண்டி வருவாயா
programme.desc: இந்து உதவி இயக்குனர், கார்த்திக் நாற்பது நாள் படப்பிடிப்பிற்கு கோவா சென்றபோது, ஜெஸ்ஸி திருமணம் செய்ய கட்டாயப்படுகிறார்.

programme.desc: கலைஞர்கள் பங்கேற்கும் நகைச்சுவைக் காட்சிகளின் தொகுப்பு பார்வையாளர்களின் பொழுதுபோக்கிற்காக தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: உடும்பன்
programme.desc: முறையான கல்வியறிவு இல்லாத ஒரு கிராமப்புற கிராமத்தை சேர்ந்த சிறு திருடனான உடும்பன், எதிர்பாராத ஒரு யோசனையைப் பெறுகிறான்.

programme.title: சாங்க்ஸ்
